label: Desk default · ranges gated
info: The engine defaults with the range gate (last 50 closes at PF 1.35) and the horizon fit.

label: Low drawdown
info: Fewer, stricter positions: at most 6 positions and 8 seats per family, min PF 1.35, Normal + Trailing only (no Block / DCA volume).

label: High frequency
info: 1m and 5m lanes, range seats, up to 20 positions and 24 seats per family; the short range beside the wide targets.

label: Combined · every range gated + Block
info: Short, minimal and micro ranges with their own seats, each through the range gate and the horizon fit, with Block.

label: All configs · highest frequency
info: Every indication × bot, every range (gated), every strategy (Normal, Trailing, Block, DCA, Axis). Measured and set at 8 symbols (every combo on more symbols needs more memory).

label: Tight stop floor (0.3 %)
info: Default book with the wide-grid stop and trail floor at 0.3 %.

label: Wide stop floor (0.8 %)
info: Default book with the wide-grid stop and trail floor at 0.8 %.

label: Block Overall · 8× stack
info: Every source (overall, symbol, direction, indication) its own Block: 8 levels, Active from 2, ratio 0.5, each source up to 7× extra, stack ≤ 8×, 7 volume steps (one lot each). General + Long ranges (Minimal / Short lose after costs).

label: Block shared · 8× stack
info: The strongest source raises the volume: 4 levels, Active from 1, ratio 0.5, stack ≤ 8×, 7 volume steps. General + Long ranges.

label: Block additive · 8× stack
info: The sources add their levels: 4 levels, Active from 1, ratio 1, stack ≤ 4×, 7 volume steps (best pooled PF of the 8× sweep). General + Long ranges.

label: General + Long ranges
info: Only the ranges that carry the edge after costs: General 16–22× and Long 24–32× position cost; Normal + Trailing, no Block volume.

label: Wide targets · tight stops (heatmap)
info: The heatmap leaders: TP 6–8 % with SL 0.5–0.75 × TP, trailing off / 0.5 / 0.75 (sim PF 1.37–1.51, positive in 5–6 of 6 windows); ranges off.

label: Wide targets · tight stops + Block Overall
info: The heatmap leaders (TP 6–8 %, SL 0.5–0.75 × TP) with Block Overall at 8× stack.

label: High order count · every evaluated config
info: The defaults with relaxed gates: no 50-close seat validation, no live last-N, min PF 1.05, symbol gate in veto mode, DDR 1. 12 windows: 4× the orders and 2.5× the net of the defaults, at PF 1.35 instead of 1.81 and a larger drawdown.
